summary: Full E2E testing of PassMate (Expo react-native-web) app + FastAPI backend. Verified onboarding, Home 'Start Adaptive Practice' bug fix, Practice tab + category cards, question answering flow, paywall (no RevenueCat singleton error), dev-mode premium unlock, real AI explanation via backend proxy, Progress + Profile tabs, and backend /api/health + /api/ai-explanation endpoints.

issues: Options are pressable but rendered as plain divs without role='button' or data-testid, making automation and screen-reader accessibility harder. Consider adding accessibilityRole='button' or testID props to options, quick-action buttons, and bottom-tab items.

action_items: (Optional) Add testID / data-testid attributes to interactive elements (options, quick actions, tab bar, paywall CTA) to make future automated testing more reliable.

(Optional) Consider a small toast/alert-modal confirmation after tapping 'Get Premium — £5.99' in dev fallback mode; currently the paywall silently closes and returns to Home which is functionally correct but slightly abrupt UX.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py: emergentintegrations LlmChat is instantiated with a fixed session_id='passmate-explanation'. This means all explanations share one Claude conversation context on the provider side. For per-question independence and to avoid context leakage / rate-limit interference, generate a fresh session_id per request (e.g. uuid4).

backend/server.py: No try/except around chat.send_message — any LLM/network failure will surface as an unhandled 500 to the client. Wrap in try/except and return HTTPException(status_code=502, detail='AI provider error') so the frontend can show a graceful fallback.
backend/server.py: No rate limiting or input length caps. A malicious client could send huge question_text strings. Add pydantic max_length constraints on each string field to protect the LLM budget.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] is fine for now but should be tightened to the actual Expo domain(s) before production.
seed_data_creation: None - real Supabase question bank used
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend served via supervisor at /api/*. Expo web dev server on port 3000 (Metro). Public URL https://a84d9224-c5f7-4586-b07f-c6eb61db1d55.preview.emergentagent.com/. Root .env has EXPO_PUBLIC_* keys (NOT /app/frontend/.env). RevenueCat is intentionally NOT configured on web - dev-fallback unlocks premium locally when 'Get Premium — £5.99' is tapped. AI explanation endpoint uses emergentintegrations LlmChat with claude-sonnet-4-6 and EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. Backend regression tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py.
